blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla expressed envy toward his colleague, Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who is currently in hiding after the International Criminal Court (ICC) issued a warrant for his arrest. Speaking to reporters at the Department of Justice (DOJ), Padilla admitted that if he were in dela Rosa’s position, he would feel a sense of pride being targeted by foreign authorities rather than by his own countrymen. “Message ko kay kumpare ko, gusto kong malaman mo, naiinggit ako sa ‘yo. ‘Yun lang,” Padilla said when asked for his message to Dela Rosa.
